Upload MR1 Data Package to Zenodo

Source: R/uploadDataPackageToZenodo.R
uploadDataPackageToZenodo.Rd

uploadDataPackageToZenodo() uploads an MR1 data package, written to disk by createDataPackage(), to Zenodo as a draft record. The function never publishes the record: check the draft on Zenodo and publish it there.

The package is first checked with validateDataPackage(); an invalid package is not uploaded. The Zenodo metadata are taken from datapackage.json:

  • title, description, version, keywords and related identifiers;

  • creators: all contributors, with ORCID and affiliation;

  • contributors: each contributor with each of their roles, and the owner as rights holder;

  • licence, and the embargo: if the embargo date is in the future, the record is embargoed (metadata public, files restricted until that date), otherwise open;

  • location of the site, and the period of the data (Collected);

  • the suggested citation, and the contact person(s) for data requests during the embargo, in the description and notes.

A DOI is reserved for the record. It is written as id in the local datapackage.json (and added to the suggested citation) before the files are uploaded, so the published package carries its own DOI. Also add it as id to the metadata file of the campaign, so new versions of the package keep it.

Usage

uploadDataPackageToZenodo(
  packageDir,
  token = NULL,
  sandbox = FALSE,
  community = "birdscanmr1community",
  addDoi = TRUE
)

Arguments

packageDir

Directory of the data package, i.e. the folder with datapackage.json written by createDataPackage().

token

Zenodo personal access token with the scopes deposit:write and deposit:actions. Default is the environment variable ZENODO_TOKEN (or ZENODO_SANDBOX_TOKEN if sandbox = TRUE). Never write the token in a script.

sandbox

logical. If TRUE, upload to the Zenodo sandbox (https://sandbox.zenodo.org) for testing, which needs its own account and token. Default is FALSE.

community

Identifier of the Zenodo community the record is submitted to when it is published. Default is "birdscanmr1community", the BirdScan MR1 community. Use NULL for none, e.g. when testing in the sandbox, where this community does not exist.

addDoi

logical. If TRUE (default), the reserved DOI is written into the local datapackage.json before the upload.

Value

A list, invisibly, with id (Zenodo record ID), doi (reserved DOI), url (link to the draft on Zenodo) and files (names of the uploaded files).

See also

Other write file functions: compileData(), createDataPackage(), createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(), saveMTR(), savePlotToFile(), validateDataPackage()

Author

Birgen Haest

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Create the data package (see createDataPackage())
# ===========================================================================
dbData = readRDS(system.file("extdata",
  "CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25_DataExtract.rds",
  package = "birdscanR"
))
mainOutputDir = file.path(".", "results")
metadataFile = file.path(mainOutputDir, "CH_Sempach_2024_metadata.yaml")
createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(filePath = metadataFile, overwrite = TRUE)
createDataPackage(
  dbExtract     = dbData,
  metadata      = metadataFile,
  outputDirPath = mainOutputDir
)

# Upload the data package as draft to the Zenodo sandbox
# ===========================================================================
# The token is read from the environment variable ZENODO_SANDBOX_TOKEN, e.g.
# set in your .Renviron file
draft = uploadDataPackageToZenodo(
  packageDir = file.path(mainOutputDir, "CH_Sempach_2024"),
  sandbox    = TRUE,
  community  = NULL
)
draft$url
} # }
